# ascii-domain

asciiDomain(domain) takes a domain string and returns exactly the documented url.domainToASCII result, including its invalid-domain result. Do not return the original Unicode input on failure, trim it, or throw a custom validation error. This is domain conversion, not URL parsing or a DNS lookup.

Run: `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.

turns.prompt:
The ascii-domain helper has a regression. First use web_fetch to open the official Node.js documentation at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/node/v22.14.0/doc/api/url.md and locate `url.domainToASCII(domain)`. If the result is truncated, find this section in the full text file supplied by the tool. Read lib/ascii-domain.cjs and tests/behavior.test.cjs, then fix the single exported function to meet this contract:
asciiDomain(domain) takes a domain string and returns exactly the documented url.domainToASCII result, including its invalid-domain result. Do not return the original Unicode input on failure, trim it, or throw a custom validation error. This is domain conversion, not URL parsing or a DNS lookup.
Change only the business module and preserve its public interface and all original tests. Use Node.js built-ins only, install nothing, make no network calls from code or tests, and write runtime artifacts only in the system temporary directory. Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs` and explain the documented rule, the fix, and the actual test result.
Related official repository behavior examples are also available at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/node/v22.14.0/test/parallel/test-url-domain-ascii-unicode.js. Locate the named section in the full-text spill file with grep/read if needed. Read these as supporting material; do not copy and run upstream tests that depend on Node repository internals.
A short official documentation change is archived at https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/ead407915e510014e5294dd4446e29d8f3f04bdc.patch; its doc/api/url.md context includes the invalid-domain return rule. Read the patch as documentation context; it is not a patch for this project.

turns.final: Return domainToASCII directly, including an empty string for invalid domains; never restore the invalid input. Fixed lib/ascii-domain.cjs; `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs` passes all original tests.
